Statute.Title: Canada–Indonesia Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement Implementation Act
Statute.OtherLangTitle: (Accord de partenariat économique global entre le Canada et l’Indonésie, Loi de mise en oeuvre de l’)

CIF.Text: CIF, 2026, c. 8 comes into force on the date of entry into force of the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement between Canada and Indonesia see SI/2026-30 — Not in force
